mapper.select: SELECT C_IDX, C_NAME, C_LOGO, C_INDUSTRY, C_EST, C_INTRO, C_NUMBER, C_BUSINESS, C_REGISTER FROM COMPANY ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{param1} OFFSET #{param2}

SELECT C.C_IDX AS C_IDX, C.C_NAME AS C_NAME, C.C_NICNAME AS C_NICNAME, C.C_LOGO AS C_LOGO, C.C_INDUSTRY AS C_INDUSTRY, C.C_EMAIL AS C_EMAIL, C.C_EST AS C_EST, C.C_INTRO AS C_INTRO, C.C_NUMBER AS C_NUMBER, C.C_BUSINESS AS C_BUSINESS, C.C_REGISTER AS C_REGISTER, C.C_UPDATE AS C_UPDATE, C.C_STATUS AS C_STATUS, C.C_CR_IDX AS C_CR_IDX FROM COMPANY C WHERE C.C_IDX = #{c_idx}
